verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. WebGPURenderer is documented as supporting compute shaders, a GPU data-parallel path for heavy scenes. A release note mentions setGeometryIdAt() visibility handling, which hints at a batched-geometry path but never names instancing. threejs.org links a devtools extension, but nothing shows it is a profiler. missing for 10: a documented real profiler (frame/GPU timing), explicit instancing/batching docs, ECS support, job/worker-based parallelism, and any hands-on corroboration of scaling heavy scenes.
